PMID:11927538.title: Lack of collagen XVIII/endostatin results in eye abnormalities.

assessment.review_notes: Selected genuine full mouse Methods/Results read: targeted Col18a1 loss, retinal vascular/vitreoretinal changes and basement-membrane immunostaining controls. Antibody recognizes a common 298-residue region; no direct current-human-isoform localization claim.

PMID:11353854.title: Platelets modulate gastric ulcer healing: role of endostatin and vascular endothelial growth factor release.

assessment.review_notes: Selected genuine full rat-treatment and HUVEC assay Methods/Results read. Anti-endostatin neutralization rescues the tested serum-associated proliferation/apoptosis effects; treatment/species/preparation are kept explicit.

PMID:10626789.title: The generation of endostatin is mediated by elastase.

assessment.review_notes: Authentic complete abstract read: EOMA-cell endostatin processing by elastase. Mouse identity is supported by the authenticated donor record, not invented from the abstract; collagen XVIII is not assigned the cleaving enzyme activity.

PMID:15254016.title: Structurally altered basement membranes and hydrocephalus in a type XVIII collagen deficient mouse line.

assessment.review_notes: Authentic complete abstract read: mouse Col18a1 loss alters basement-membrane thickness/structure with strain-dependent hydrocephalus and other tissue findings. Supports matrix maintenance, not a new catalytic mechanism.

PMID:12798059.title: Mechanical factors influence the expression of endostatin--an inhibitor of angiogenesis--in tendons.

assessment.review_notes: Authentic complete abstract read: human tendon localization and rat tendon-cell intermittent-pressure experiment. Conditioned-medium inhibition is not uniquely assigned to endostatin because target-specific neutralization is not described in the available abstract.
